sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to maintain their excellent form. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, having won their most recent fixture and strung together five consecutive wins before a recent draw. Alsager are rock bottom with just 4 points from 10 matches and have lost their last five games, making them severe underdogs in this clash.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a mid-table encounter, with Stafford chasing Sandbach but coming off a recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host Eccleshall in a top-half fixture, though Bridgnorth are looking to bounce back from their only recent defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a clash between two mid-table sides, both showing mixed recent form. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town, with Bilston having won their last outing and sitting sixth. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-half battle, while Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills—both teams struggling with recent losses. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half fixture between two sides with poor recent records. Shawbury United host Barnton, with Shawbury seeking to improve after a disastrous run of five consecutive defeats. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town; Widnes remain pointless in the league with just 2 points from 7 games.
